title: Extracting audio-frame features
description: You can follow repeated slices into energy and sign-change arrays.

steps.description: FRAME and HOP determine slice length and spacing in samples. You generate the starting indices used by both feature calculations.
energy contains the mean squared amplitude for each slice. You calculate one scalar from every selected audio frame.

steps.question: Do energy and zcr use different frame starts?
steps.answer: No. Both comprehensions use starts, and frame_t assigns a shared center coordinate to those frames.

steps.description: The zcr expression summarizes sign changes, labeled zero-crossing rate on the plot. You display energy and zcr on two shared-axis panels; the recording supplies no rendered figure or text values.
